verification.note: Publisher description read: antimodernism as 'the effort among middle- and upper-class Americans to recapture feelings of authentic experience' in response to 'the emergent culture of corporate capitalism'; it 'helped accommodate Americans to the new order', 'therapeutic rather than oppositional'.
